_note: Gilbert Pulse has no HTTP routes of its own. Its events live in packages/catalog/assistant.json, and a person reaches Gilbert through Access's conversation and tool routes. This file exists so the twelve engines are all accounted for, and so the speech-transcript door is linked to the engine it serves.

refusals.statement: Gilbert Pulse answers no HTTP route of its own.
refusals.why: The patient-facing layer speaks through Access, where the callers, purposes and allow-list are enforced.

noRoutesBecause: The Pulse Interaction Engine coordinates what the patient sees and hears on the device. Everything it asks of another engine goes through Access's tool gateway.
